# /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.service
[Unit]
Description=Back up inventory data
ConditionPathIsDirectory=/srv/inventory/data

[Service]
Type=oneshot
User=root
Group=root
UMask=0077
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
Nice=10
IOSchedulingClass=best-effort
IOSchedulingPriority=7
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=true
PrivateTmp=true
NoNewPrivileges=true
ReadOnlyPaths=/srv/inventory/data
ReadWritePaths=/var/backups/inventory
[inventory-backup.timer]
# /etc/systemd/system/inventory-backup.timer
[Unit]
Description=Daily inventory data backup

[Timer]
OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=true
AccuracySec=1min
Unit=inventory-backup.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
timer_persistent=yes
timer_calendar={ OnCalendar=*-*-* 02:00:00 ; next_elapse=Thu 2026-09-03 02:00:00 EDT }
timer_enabled=enabled
timer_active=active
